summary:
Implementation plan for fiberMAP:
- Fluid map panning and zoom without gesture lock.
- Automatic camera centering and zoom when clicking lines or pin entries from list/detail views.
- Hold-click (long-press) anywhere on the map to drop pins, supporting off-road client drops.
- Direct repair logging with optical splice loss metrics (e.g., 0.01 dBm / dB) and immediate cut-to-repair status transition.
